description: Deterministic rule logic the application should apply when converting a model prediction + farmer context into a farmer-facing response. This file contains WORKFLOW LOGIC only, not agricultural facts - all facts must be pulled from disease_database.json / pest_database.json / crop_pest_mapping.json / disease_crop_mapping.json at runtime.

input_schema.prediction_id: matches an id in disease_database.json or pest_database.json

confidence_threshold_config.note: Tune this threshold using validation-set accuracy for each model; do not hardcode without evaluating your specific trained model's calibration.
confidence_threshold_config.low_confidence_message: Prediction confidence is low. Please upload a clearer image or consult an agricultural expert.

pipeline_steps.name: confidence_gate
pipeline_steps.logic: IF confidence < confidence_threshold_config.default_threshold THEN return low_confidence_message AND STOP (do not proceed to lookup).

pipeline_steps.name: identify_prediction
pipeline_steps.logic: Look up prediction_id in disease_database.json (if prediction_type=='disease') or pest_database.json (if prediction_type=='pest'). IF no matching record exists THEN return: 'This condition is not yet in our verified knowledge base. Please consult your local KVK or agriculture department.' AND STOP.

pipeline_steps.name: confirm_crop_compatibility
pipeline_steps.logic: For disease: compare input crop against record.crop.common_name (and disease_crop_mapping.json for cross-crop pathogens). For pest: check crop_pest_mapping.json for a record with matching pest_id and crop with relationship.verified_host==true. IF crop does not match / is not a verified host THEN return a warning that this prediction is unusual for the stated crop and recommend photo/expert re-verification, but do not block the response entirely - flag it prominently.

pipeline_steps.name: retrieve_india_guidance
pipeline_steps.logic: Pull management/integrated_pest_management fields from the matched record. Check record.data_quality.status. IF status == 'not_verified' THEN the response MUST state this record has not yet been verified and route to a generic KVK/expert-consultation message instead of fabricated steps.

pipeline_steps.name: management_priority_order
pipeline_steps.logic: When presenting management options, ALWAYS present in this order, and only include a tier if the record has non-empty, non-placeholder content for it: A. monitoring_and_confirmation, B. cultural_management, C. mechanical_or_physical_management (or mechanical_physical for pests), D. biological_management, E. official_chemical_guidance (ONLY IF official_chemical_guidance.available == true).
pipeline_steps.note: Never reorder to put chemical guidance first, even if it is the only verified tier available - always frame chemical guidance as a later-tier option alongside the non-chemical tiers when they exist.

pipeline_steps.name: chemical_guidance_gate
pipeline_steps.logic: IF official_chemical_guidance.available == false THEN the response MUST use this exact fallback text and MUST NOT generate any chemical name, dose, or product: 'Consult your local KVK, agriculture department, or licensed agricultural expert for currently approved treatment options.'
pipeline_steps.additional_note: Even when official_chemical_guidance.available == true, always append record.management.official_chemical_guidance.important_note verbatim, since it typically contains critical caveats (e.g., dated sources, unconfirmed registration status).

pipeline_steps.name: severity_adjustment
pipeline_steps.logic: Use input severity to select the matching key in record.severity_guidance (mild/moderate/high) as supplementary guidance layered on top of, not instead of, the management tiers from step 5.

pipeline_steps.name: assemble_farmer_response
pipeline_steps.logic: Populate the farmer-facing output schema (see output_schema below) using only fields sourced from the matched database record. Do not add any recommendation not present in the record.

output_schema.immediate_steps: step 5 tiers A-D content, farmer-friendly phrasing
output_schema.important_warning: record.farmer_warning + always append the fixed AI-decision-support disclaimer (see disclaimers below)

always_append_disclaimer: AI predictions are decision-support information and should not replace professional agricultural advice. Treatment decisions should follow current, crop-specific, and region-specific guidance.
unverified_record_fallback_message: Our records for this condition are still being verified against official sources. For safe, up-to-date guidance, please contact your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), state agriculture department, or a licensed agricultural expert.
